title: Persona X – Dynamic Resume & Portfolio SaaS Platform
tagline: Multi-tenant, API-first resumes, CVs, and portfolio sites
intro: A subscription SaaS that centralizes career data and generates resumes, CVs, and portfolio websites on demand.
summary: Co-founded under A Squared Tech. Backend-first architecture with Express.js and PostgreSQL, Clerk auth, and REST APIs powering a Next.js front. Built for scalability, extensibility, and secure multi-user access.
features: User data store for education, work, projects, skills
Automated CV/portfolio generation with downloadable PDFs
Hosted portfolio sites with customizable themes
API-first design for integrations and AI agents
Clerk-powered authentication and secure session handling
Modular backend for incremental feature delivery

sections.title: Description
sections.body: A SaaS that helps professionals maintain a single source of truth for career data and generate resumes, CVs, and portfolio sites on demand.

sections.title: Objective / Aim
sections.body: Replace fragmented CV editing with a dynamic, data-driven system. Serve as a professional identity hub accessible by users and AI agents.

sections.title: Role & Responsibilities
sections.body: Backend architecture with Express.js and PostgreSQL; REST endpoints for generation flows; collaborate on Next.js front; Clerk auth integration; design multi-tenant RBAC.

sections.title: Features / Implementation
sections.body: Data models for profiles; PDF pipelines; themeable portfolio hosting; API-first separation for future third-party integrations; strict auth/authorization boundaries.

sections.title: Challenges & Solutions
sections.body: Scalability addressed with API-first boundaries and clean modularity; steady co-founder cadence enabled by isolating domains and CI-enforced contracts.

sections.title: Impact / Results
sections.body: Early validation shows faster, more consistent resume/portfolio creation; foundation is enterprise-capable.

sections.title: Future Plans
sections.body: AI resume optimization and job matching; team/enterprise tiers with analytics; Stripe billing and full production launch.
